{{Youmay|the exhibit|the novel ''[[Servants of the Empire: Imperial Justice]]''}}
"'''Imperial Justice: Triumph of the New Order'''" was an exhibit held at the [[Imperial Heritage Museum]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as well as during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Post-Imperial era/Legends|era]]. The exhibit examined the case of [[Vune Willic]], an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who was found guilty of attempting to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

==Pieces==
Multiple exhibits were featured in "Imperial Justice: Triumph of the New Order" to showcase how the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Vune Willic]] came to be [[Death/Legends|executed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for the crime of attemting to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. A message from Willic to his [[Parent/Legends|parents]] that wrote of the his arrival to [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]], the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], was shown in the exhibit. The message was written as Willic was transported a few levels from a [[Hangar/Legends|landing pad]] in the planet's [[Senate District/Legends|Senate district]] to his grandfather home near<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030403coruscant|text=Coruscant: Center of the Empire|int=Coruscant: Center of the Empire}}</ref> the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]].<ref name="ITW">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>

[[File:YsanneIsard-HS.jpg|thumb|right|185px|Security Director Ysanne Isard]]
Another exhibit was an entry in Willic's triple-encrypted personal holographic journal that detailed his meeting with [[Ysanne Isard]], [[Director/Legends|Security Director]] of<ref name="Wizards" /> [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence's]] [[Internal Security Branch]].<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==History==
"Imperial Justice: Triumph of the New Order" was a feature of the Imperial Heritage Museum,<ref name="Wizards" /> an institution dedicated to preserving the Empire's documents and relics<ref name="CSWE-Museum">{{CSWECite|II|90|Imperial Heritage Museum}}</ref> which was located in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on<ref name="Wizards" /> Coruscant,<ref name="CSWE-Museum" /> the capital of the Empire and later the New Republic.<ref name="CSWE-Coruscant">{{CSWECite|I|146&ndash;147|Coruscant}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
"Imperial Justice: Triumph of the New Order" was mentioned throughout "[[Coruscant: Center of the Empire]]," an article series of the ''[[Planet Hoppers]]'' online supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. Written by [[Cory J. Herndon]], the article series was published on [[Wizards.com]] from [[April 3]] to [[April 24]] in [[2003]].<ref name="Wizards" />
